payload.meaning: Derive the public verifier from the local credential seats. No payload value is read.

publicKey.meaning: Lowercase hexadecimal Ed25519 public key from the derived signer.

epoch.meaning: Lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 of the public key bytes.

exceptionType.meaning: Exception class when the front door catches an unhandled stop exception.

firstMissingSignal.meaning: The child binding refusal passed back in JSON, or the front-door exception signal. Omitted on success.

stderr.meaning: Raw diagnostic lines on the non-JSON error path. An internal failure also prints a leading exception-class and diagnostic line; no receipt is emitted on these paths.
